headline: CSU Pueblo's perfect start ends at Colorado Mesa
dek: CSU Pueblo had won every match they played until Colorado Mesa held them. Seven wins and one draw is still a record without a defeat, and the points dropped are the first of their season.
displaced_by: results night: CSU Pueblo drop their first points of the season in a draw at Colorado Mesa
